# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This project is a self-hosted service, deployed continuously from the `main` branch rather than released as versioned packages. Only the latest code on `main` is supported — there are no older maintained branches or release lines to track separately.

| Version       | Supported          |
| ------------- | ------------------ |
| `main` (latest) | :white_check_mark: |
| Older commits | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, report it privately via GitHub's [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/Millroy094/oidc-auth-serverless/security/advisories/new) (repository **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**). This creates a private discussion visible only to maintainers until a fix is ready.

When reporting, please include:
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept if available.
- Any relevant logs, requests/responses, or configuration details (with secrets redacted).

You can expect an initial acknowledgement within a few days. If the report is confirmed, a fix will be prioritized and released as soon as reasonably possible, and you'll be credited (if desired) once it's resolved. If declined, you'll receive an explanation of why it isn't considered a valid security issue.
